name: cult-of-the-cow
description: Cult of the Cow: a mooving parody. Mobile game built with HTML5 canvas, packaged with Capacitor.

scripts.sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.android: npm run sync && npx cap open android
scripts.ios: npm run sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.apk: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
